title: A spent script still instructs the operator to patch a mainnet-addresses key that story 078 deleted
fingerprintNote: PRE-COMPUTED AND VALIDATED upstream; copied verbatim, never recomputed. fingerprintInput is recorded for provenance only.
description:
`DeployMainnetMintPageView.s.sol:94` still prints the operator instruction "(patch mainnet-addresses.ts MintPageView -> this)". Story 078 deleted the `MintPageView` address-book key and swept the dangling references in `package.json` and in both JS patchers — but not this Solidity site. The script is itself spent; the instruction it prints now names a key that no longer exists.

This is filed STANDALONE and deliberately NOT merged with L-04 (the spent rewire one-shot): different file, different fix site, different root cause. Merging them would let a fix to one silently mark the other resolved.
impact: Documentation only, and fails visibly: an operator who follows the instruction finds no MintPageView key to patch and stops immediately. No state is reachable from following it.
recommendation: Delete or amend the line 94 instruction to state that MintPageView is no longer an address-book key and that view addresses now resolve through ViewRouter. Sweep the remaining Solidity scripts for the same class of stale operator instruction.
doNotMerge: Standalone. NOT merged with L-04 — different file, different fix site, different root cause. Merging would let one fix silently mark the other resolved.
evidence: Story 078 deleted the MintPageView address-book key and swept package.json + both JS patchers — but not this Solidity site.
Following the instruction fails immediately and visibly (no such key).
